strategies.world: A simulated ops incident-response backend spanning four subsystems that share ids and state: (1) a status API tracking services named api, checkout, payments, auth (any other name is treated as an unlisted-but-valid service) with state in {healthy, degraded, down}, a 5-minute error_rate_pct, an open_incidents count, and an ISO8601 last_deploy timestamp — checkout is currently degraded (12.4% errors, 1 open incident, deployed 2026-09-07T08:15:00Z), payments is degraded (8.2% errors, 1 open incident, deployed 2026-09-06T19:40:00Z), auth is healthy, and api is the generic healthy default; (2) a runbook library keyed by id RB-01, RB-07, RB-08, RB-14, RB-15, RB-22 covering checkout 5xx spikes, deploy rollbacks, payments latency/circuit-breaker, auth token failures, and a generic 5xx triage checklist; (3) a ticketing system that mints ids INC-1042 (checkout sev2, open), INC-1043 (payments sev1, acknowledged), and a generic counter starting at INC-1050 for anything else, incrementing per new distinct ticket; (4) an on-call/paging roster where team 'checkout' pages Maria Chen (eta 8m), team 'payments' pages Rahul Iyer (eta 4m, escalated) for sev1, and any other team falls to the 'platform' rotation (eta ~10m); and a status-page/Slack publisher that echoes channel+severity+message with a posted_at timestamp near the current date 2026-09-07. All ids and canned facts above are stable across strategies; strategies only govern novel inputs not covered by the fixed matches.

default.description: Healthy backend: known services/queries/teams resolve to their canned fixture facts; unknown inputs resolve to sensible, low-severity synthetic data rather than errors.

get_service_status.behavior: If service is 'checkout', 'payments', or 'auth', return the exact fixture status for that service. If service is omitted, empty, or 'api', return the healthy api fixture. For any other unrecognized service name, echo that service name back with state='healthy', error_rate_pct between 0.1 and 0.6, open_incidents=0, and last_deploy a plausible ISO8601 timestamp within the last 5 days of 2026-09-07.

search_runbooks.behavior: Match query text against known symptom keywords: 'checkout'+'500'/'5xx' → RB-14 and RB-15; 'payments'+'latency' → RB-07 and RB-08; 'auth'+'token' → RB-22 alone; anything else → the generic RB-01 5xx triage checklist. Truncate the results list to the requested limit (default 3). Always echo back the query and severity given.
